title: Cursor for iPad Released
description: Cursor expanded its multi-platform availability with the release of Cursor for iPad, bringing AI-powered coding to tablet devices.

title: Cursor Start Feature Launch
description: Cursor introduced Start, a new feature that includes access to Grok 4.5 (fixed medium effort, non-fast) model options.

title: v0.53.0: LLM Triage Orchestrator and Security Enhancements
description: Implemented LLM triage orchestrator, container build setup, evaluation coverage report generation, workspace trust enforcement, and task isolation. Fixed infinite ReAct/prompt injection loops and other security issues.

title: Grok 4.5 Model Added
description: xAI's Grok 4.5 model is now available in GitHub Copilot, providing developers with another AI model option.

title: Claude Opus 5 Model Added
description: Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 model is now available in GitHub Copilot, expanding the AI model options for developers.

title: Cursor Router Released
description: Cursor launched Router, a navigation enhancement that routes tasks efficiently. The system uses Grok 4.5 as a price-efficient routing option.
